description_en: Queries the list of hybrid cloud node groups added to Web Application Firewall (WAF)
description_zh: 查询添加到Web应用防火墙的混合云节点组列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-groups --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-00000000w0b --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudGroups

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the hybrid cloud node group to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的混合云节点组名称
parameters.name: group_display_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the hybrid cloud node group. Valid values:

protect: protection.

control: management.

storage: storage.

controlStorage: management and storage
parameters.help_zh:
混合云节点组类型。取值：

protect：防护。

control：管控。

storage：存储。

controlStorage：管控＆存储
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页的行数。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The proxy type of the cluster. Valid values:

service: SDK integration.

cname: reverse proxy
parameters.help_zh:
集群代理类型。取值：

service：SDK集成。

cname：反向代理
parameters.name: cluster_proxy_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Groups.description_en: The collection of hybrid cloud node groups

items.description_en: The information about a single hybrid cloud node

BackSourceMark.description_en:
The back-to-origin mark of the protection cluster, in the format of {Protection Cluster ISP Name}-{Protection Cluster Continent Name}-{Protection Cluster City Name}-{Protection Cluster Back-to-origin Identifier} (optional).

For the list of values for the protection cluster ISP name, continent name, city name, and back-to-origin identifier, see the supplementary description of response elements
BackSourceMark.description_zh:
防护集群回源标记，格式为 {防护集群运营商Name}-{防护集群大洲Name}-{防护集群城市Name}-{防护集群回源标识}（可选）

防护集群运营商Name、防护集群大洲Name、防护集群城市Name、防护集群回源标识的取值列表，见返回参数补充说明

ContinentsValue.description_en:
The continent code of the protection cluster.

For the list of code values, see the supplementary description of response elements
ContinentsValue.description_zh:
防护集群大洲Code。

Code的取值列表，见返回参数补充说明

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the hybrid cloud node group

GroupName.description_en: The name of the hybrid cloud node group

GroupType.description_en:
The type of the hybrid cloud node group. Valid values:

protect: protection.

control: management.

storage: storage.

controlStorage: management and storage
GroupType.description_zh:
混合云节点组类型。取值：

protect：防护。

control：管控。

storage：存储。

controlStorage：管控＆存储

LocationId.description_en: The ID of the protection node

OperatorValue.description_en:
The ISP code of the protection cluster.

For the list of code values, see the supplementary description of response elements
OperatorValue.description_zh:
防护集群运营商Code。

Code的取值列表，见返回参数补充说明

Ports.description_en: The ports used by the hybrid cloud cluster. The value is a string. When multiple ports are used, they are returned in the format of port1,port2,port3
Ports.description_zh:
混合云集群使用的端口。  取值为字符串，
多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回

RegionCodeValue.description_en:
The city code of the protection cluster.

For the list of code values, see the supplementary description of response elements
RegionCodeValue.description_zh:
防护集群城市Code。

Code的取值列表，见返回参数补充说明

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is the identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
